entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration
entities.description: A procedure that allows the network to provide the UE with reconfiguration parameters that are applied only when certain conditions are met.

entities.name: Condition
entities.description: A set of criteria that must be satisfied for the conditional reconfiguration to be applied.

entities.name: Reconfiguration Parameters
entities.description: Configuration settings provided by the network that are applied when the conditional criteria are met.

relations.description: The conditional reconfiguration procedure is guarded by specific conditions that must be met for execution.
The conditional reconfiguration procedure establishes the application of reconfiguration parameters when conditions are satisfied.
